::: {.callout-important}
### Canvas login required
**To access the marking rubric, you must be logged into the University of Sydney Canvas system with your UniKey.**
:::

## Accessing the Marking Rubric {.unnumbered}

The official marking rubric for Report 1 is hosted directly on Canvas:

- [**Download Report 1 Marking Rubric (PDF)**](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353/files/52398578/download?download_frd=1) (Canvas file: `BIOL2022-R01-rubric-2026.pdf`)
- [**View Assignment on Canvas**](https://canvas.sydney.edu.au/courses/74353/assignments/696331){target="_blank"} to view the submission portal and the interactive marking criteria grid displayed below the assignment description.

For comprehensive writing advice, section-by-section breakdown, and formatting guidelines, refer to the [Report 1 Instructions](204-report1.qmd){target="_blank"} page.
